title: Ender Smelting
description: Adds an Ender Furnace. A little expensive, but smelts faster.
body:
# Summary of Features
A simple Fabric mod adding an Ender Furnace. The inventory is saved in the same manner as the Ender Chest is handled.

Recipe:

![Ender Furnace crafting recipe. Same as Ender Chest, but the bottommost Obsidian is swapped out for a regular Furnace.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67421e4d133b62b28d3438bf69971f173f0defe7.png)

The crafting recipe is similar to the Ender Chest's.

Currently released for 1.20.1. Ports to newer versions might come later.
